_comment: BINDING prefill spec. Only carries what the HF config and the checkpoint CANNOT tell you, plus the few targets the bring-up is graded against. Anything readable from config.json - dims, layer count, attention family, rope, vocab, norm eps, expert counts, checkpoint quantization - is NOT here; read it from the config. Where a donor conflicts with this file, this file wins.

shapes._note: max_seq_len is the prefill sequence length to bring up (the model's max context). Both values must satisfy % (32 * sp) == 0 - chunk_size is the block-cyclic addressing period of the KV table, so a misaligned value corrupts addresses silently rather than failing.

dataformats._note: ttnn dtype spellings: bfloat16 | bfloat8_b | bfloat4_b | float32. Three independent groups, each with its own default. An empty or absent override inherits that group's default.
